2226-5921-6844.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-5921-6844.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

116-907-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-907-2645-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

826-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
826-4881-6909-8200.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-4881-6909-8200.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing [creature] to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

4826-5531-5694-6991-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4826-5531-5694-6991-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4826-5531-5694-6991-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Donnie & April and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2738-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding one mana.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate that Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2111-2511-3545.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

188-3459-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Lavamancer's Skill by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2438-2626-3661-4986.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2457-5794-6753-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2946-3220-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3220-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-2654-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-2654-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Shark Typhoon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

891-2034-7424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

2558-3000-6737-6797.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

465-4605-5686-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-4605-5686-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

3967-4871-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3967-4871-5220-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3967-4871-5220-6650.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

233-2645-5234-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {B} as it's a Swamp land due to Toph and Urborg
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {B}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2511-3025-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-3534-6156.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1483-4050-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

236-1978-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
236-1978-5527.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Bring to Life.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

549-1651-5640-6857.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Kragma Butcher, targeting Kragma Butcher.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
549-1651-5640-6857.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

1350-2793-5147-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

81-1495-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
81-1495-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

3812-6287-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 6 or greater.
3812-6287-6478.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Arbor Adherent.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Simic Ragworm.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2281-4549-5006-5686.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

2665-5733-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2665-5733-5913.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the token Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2499-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

1283-1350-4659-5432.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1283-1350-4659-5432.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents who each control at least one artifact.
1283-1350-4659-5432.description:
Cast Journey On either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1} and commander tax, if applicable, creating at least three Map artifact tokens and exiling Journey On with the ability to cast it from exile.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing three Maps, adding six {C}.
Cast Kellan from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {3}, returning Kellan from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you have at least three opponents who each control an artifact, once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Maps, and you may use the Maps to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

656-2173-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

719-2122-3384-4997.notablePrerequisites:
Mindless Automaton has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
"Merfolk" or "Knight" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2122-3384-4997.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

512-1636-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Halo Fountain does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {W}.
512-1636-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Halo Fountain to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

112-2020-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Vadrik has a power of three or greater.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
112-2020-5115.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}, putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2034-4365-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
2034-4365-5320.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-4365-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

283-1978-4474-5077-5235.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Voltaic Construct.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
283-1978-4474-5077-5235.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {1}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Brokers Hideout from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Brokers Hideout enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Plains, Island or Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, targeting Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Voltaic Construct's ability, targeting Scaretiller.
Resolve the copy of Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the original Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

2438-4504-4766.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches.
Endless Cockroaches dies, triggering itself and Deathrender.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Endless Cockroaches onto the battlefield from your hand, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

30-147-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-5147.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-5147.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.
